item.title: TTT 338: Fur Panties
item.description:
We bring you the best because we are the best; in Calgary at least. So until someone tells us otherwise we’ll keep on claiming it. We have Eurovision songs from Iceland and Malta (where ever that is) and also a video of a ten year relationship expert that both Eric and Rachelle want to punch in the face.
